lines: Saitou Hanjirou
「Haah haah......」
Saitou's smug face had completely changed.
It was no wonder.
After all, he had taken such a severe wound to the gut.
Igawa Kageomi
「Well, what are you gonna do, Serial Killer-san?」
Kageomi said, while alertly readying himself.
Round One had been his win.
He had dealt Saitou a severe blow.
However, he wasn't about to get carried away here.
That would be no different from Saitou, just before.
Kageomi made a deduction.
As to the secret of Saitou's ninja arts.
It wouldn't do to rush.
If he acted in haste, he would mess up.
The golden rule for making your assassination a success was to keep it simple.
He killed calmly. And, indeed, naturally, as naturally as he preferred the croissants from the café in front of the station with his morning coffee.
The key to killing simply and naturally was to expose the true identity of Saitou's ninja arts.
Which was why, even though he had dealt him a serious wound, he wasn't going to panic and sprint to the finish.
Igawa Kageomi
「You grow two arms......」
Igawa Kageomi
「You suddenly disappear and circle around behind me......」
Igawa Kageomi
「And, you blow up whatever you touch......」
Igawa Kageomi
「What kind of ninja art is that? What kind of ninja art would make that possible?」
Saitou Hanjirou
「Haah haah haah......」
Igawa Kageomi
「What happened to all that chatter from before? You like complicated discussions, right?」
He had to unravel the mystery of Saitou's ninja arts.
Once solved, Kageomi's victory would be secure.
Saitou Hanjirou
「Haah haah...」
Igawa Kageomi
All of a sudden, there were grenades in Saitou's hands.
There was no sign of him having taken them out from anywhere.
He hadn't performed any such movement.
And yet, before Kageomi knew it, he was holding them.
And what was more, three or four in both hands.
Igawa Kageomi
「Is that the trick behind the explosions?!」
Where had he been hiding hand grenades like those?!
How had he retrieved them?
Saitou Hanjirou
「Please, take some.」
Saitou tossed the hand grenades.
As if throwing a ball, so naturally that Kageomi nearly caught them on instinct.
Igawa Kageomi
「Tch!」
Kageomi reflexively pulled back.
He still couldn't figure out the mystery of Saitou's ninja arts.
Even though they were just hand grenades, it would be dangerous to be hit by them head-on.
The shockwaves from multiple explosions spread across the confined alley.
Like when they had destroyed the drones, they inflicted damage through those shockwaves, rather than sending fragments flying in the explosions.
The killing range for that type of offensive grenade was just a few metres, and it only had an effect within a relatively limited area.
Despite that, since the shockwaves went around obstructions to inflict damage, they were handy to use indoors, or in urban areas like this.
Furthermore, it appeared that the ones that Saitou used had a more narrow effect range than usual.
Grenades for carefully and reliably blowing up the people he targeted one by one, or something like that?
Igawa Kageomi
（The serial killer uses some nasty weapons, doesn't he?）
Igawa Kageomi
「But, well, they're ordinary hand grenades, right?」
Kageomi judged, seeing the circumstances following the explosions.
He himself had escaped from their killing range, and explosions of that magnitude would be no problem, no matter where on his body he was hit.
That was his ninja art.
The three people that Saitou had left alone without killing earlier were all dead, but that was no big deal.
What mattered was the fact that his bloodstains were continuing, drop after drop, in the direction of the main street.
It seemed that Saitou had fled during the explosions just now.
The fact that he ran away meant that he had been driven into a corner.
It was also conceivable that he had given Kageomi that impression to lure him into some kind of trap, just as he had lured him into this alley, but he wasn't going to fall for that trick.
Igawa Kageomi
「It's a futile struggle.」
While getting in touch with the Cabinet Intelligence and Research Office and asking them to deal with the bodies, Kageomi began his pursuit.
